events.text:
No upload needed for this approach: here’s a **4:5 SVG poster** with your exact design. Save the code below as **`night-market.svg`** to open or print it.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="800" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 800 1000">
  <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="#B64C2E"/>

  <!-- Simple crescent moon -->
  <defs>
    <mask id="crescent">
      <rect width="800" height="1000" fill="white"/>
      <circle cx="439" cy="231" r="78" fill="black"/>
    </mask>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="400" cy="255" r="88"
          fill="#FFF0D3" mask="url(#crescent)"/>

  <!-- Bold cream lettering -->
  <g fill="#FFF0D3"
     font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
     font-weight="900"
     text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="400" y="535" font-size="142"
          letter-spacing="-5">NIGHT</text>
    <text x="400" y="675" font-size="142"
          letter-spacing="-5">MARKET</text>
    <text x="400" y="834" font-size="37"
          font-weight="700"
          letter-spacing="2">SATURDAY 6–10 PM</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
